name: VoiceLab
description: Speech AI for Uzbek, Russian, and English: text-to-speech with natural voices, speech-to-text with timing and speaker labels, voice isolation with noise removal, and LLM completions.

com.openai.interface.longDescription: VoiceLab provides production-grade speech AI capabilities through Model Context Protocol (MCP). Generate natural speech in Uzbek, Russian, and English with professional TTS voices. Transcribe audio with word-level timing and speaker diarization. Remove background noise with voice isolation. Access Aisha LLM for Uzbek language understanding. All tools use base64 for audio I/O and support idempotent operations.
capabilities: Text-to-Speech: Generate speech from text in Uzbek, Russian, and English with natural voices
Speech-to-Text: Transcribe audio with word timing and optional speaker labels
Voice Isolation: Remove background noise with optional speech restoration
LLM Completions: Chat with Aisha models for Uzbek language tasks
Voice Management: List and discover available voices by language
Realtime Support: Create WebSocket tickets for streaming TTS/STT
defaultPrompts: Generate Uzbek speech for: Salom, dunyo!
Transcribe this audio file with speaker labels
Remove background noise from this recording

test_cases.prompt: Use VoiceLab to generate speech in Uzbek for: Assalomu alaykum
test_cases.expected_outcome: Returns base64-encoded WAV audio with Uzbek speech

test_cases.prompt: Transcribe this audio file with speaker labels using VoiceLab
test_cases.expected_outcome: Returns transcription with word timing and speaker labels

test_cases.prompt: Show me all available Russian voices in VoiceLab
test_cases.expected_outcome: Returns list of Russian voices with metadata

test_cases.prompt: Remove background noise from this audio using VoiceLab
test_cases.expected_outcome: Returns job ID, then isolated audio URL when complete

test_cases.expected_outcome: Returns completion text with token usage
Returns validation error indicating invalid voice_id

test_cases.prompt: Transcribe audio without providing any audio file

publication.release_notes: Initial release: Full VoiceLab MCP integration with TTS, STT, voice isolation, and LLM capabilities. Supports Uzbek, Russian, and English languages. Base64 audio I/O. Idempotent operations. Async job polling for STT and isolation.
